# Talking Head Recut Skill for Muse

Takes an existing talking-head, interview, or podcast video and layers timed, designed graphic cards over it — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to what's being said; the clip itself plays untouched underneath. The workflow is agentic with checkpoints: you confirm aspect ratio, layout, style group, and card pacing before it drafts the storyboard; transcription runs locally with Whisper (no API key, no proxy); each card is authored as self-contained HTML, compiled into a shared animation timeline, then rendered to MP4 via the hyperframes CLI. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it needs the hyperframes CLI plus ffmpeg/ffprobe on your machine, and it's interactive — a few questions to answer before the render; it builds designed overlays, not plain subtitles and not a video from scratch. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
